title: The moss-grown wight guardian in the Cutter's Barrow chamber advertises two non-combat resolutions ('read the verse-stone (wits)' and 'swear the rest-oath (will)') alongside combat. After one failed wits roll I fought it instead; killing it silently removed both alternate options, and the verse the room was built around was never actually readable — no warning that fighting would forfeit that content permanently.
